title: Open compact-support exchange is the extension-composition mate
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Work on the small etale sites with the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], exact constant-coefficient inverse image [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], and derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. All schemes mentioned are Noetherian [def-pc-scheme]. Compact-support direct image is the compactification-independent functor of [def-amb-etale-compact-support, lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Let $f:X\to S$ be separated finite type and compactifiable [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], let $u:U\hookrightarrow S$ be open, and put $X_U=X\times_SU$, $v:X_U\hookrightarrow X$, and $f_U:X_U\to U$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-open-immersion]. Use termwise open extension $Du_!,Dv_!$ with the sum/evaluation adjunctions $Du_!\dashv u^*$, $Dv_!\dashv v^*$ [lem-asd-etale-compact-support-normalization, lem-amb-etale-adjoint-locality]. Under the normalized identification of compact support along an open with its extension by zero, let
$$\delta_M:Rf_!Dv_!M\xrightarrow{\sim}Du_!Rf_{U!}M$$
be $\alpha_{u,f_U}^{-1}\circ\alpha_{f,v}$, for the composition comparisons of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons] and $fv=uf_U$. Let $C_{f,u,F}:u^*Rf_!F\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf_{U!}v^*F$ be the canonical compact-support exchange. For every $F\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, the morphism
$$\kappa_F=Rf_!(\varepsilon_{v,F})\circ\delta_{v^*F}^{-1}:Du_!Rf_{U!}v^*F\longrightarrow Rf_!F$$
has adjunct $C_{f,u,F}^{-1}$ under $Du_!\dashv u^*$. Equivalently,
$$\kappa_F=\varepsilon_{u,Rf_!F}\circ Du_!(C_{f,u,F}^{-1}).$$
Here $\varepsilon_u,\varepsilon_v$ are the evaluation counits. Thus the right-adjoint restriction isomorphism obtained by the Hom chain through $Dv_!$, $\delta$, and $Du_!$ is paired with this specific exchange $C_{f,u}$ [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. No boundedness assumption on $F$ is made.
